derivation_policy.pavement: Paved and Unpaved are derived only from supplied OSM surface tags; missing or unfamiliar surfaces remain Unclassified.
derivation_policy.condition: Good, Fair and Poor are derived only from supplied OSM smoothness tags; missing values remain Unclassified.
derivation_policy.management_class: Functional classes are analytical candidates based on OSM highway tags, not statutory ownership assignments.
derivation_policy.missing_values: Not supplied values remain explicit and are never imputed.
